L17: cite9†Image L18: ### Dear Customers,
L19: 
L20: we would like to inform you that due to organisational changes, we have finished production of zinc products. As of 08 January 2024, we will no longer be supplying of zinc wires. At the same time, we would like to thank our partners for their cooperation to date.
L21: 
L22: cite10†Image L23: ### Who are we?
L24: 
L25: CC POLSKA Biuro Handlowe has been present in Poland since 2009. We offer deliveries of titanium dioxide pigments, powder coatings (electrostatic spraying) and materials for the production of plant protection products.
L26: 
L27: cite11†Image L28: 
L29: ### Why us?
L30: 
L31: With an individual approach to each order and by offering products at manufacturer prices, we are able to guarantee a partnership-based cooperation.
L32: 
L33: cite12†Image L34: ### Our experience
L35: 
L36: In doing business, we make use of 150 years of experience and tradition of Cinkarna Celje, Slovenian company established in 1873. Today, Cinkarna Celje is one of the largest companies dealing with chemical processing, its core operations being the manufacturing and sale of titanium dioxide pigment. Our broad offering includes also production of masterbatches, powder coatings and plant protection agents.
